text: This company continues to violate my consumer rights by reporting inaccurate information on my credit file and trying to make that account seem like it's new when it's closed and old and have been reinsert on my credit file to make my credit look bad. I have proof down below to show how this company continues to do so. They also said that every time I dispute this account they said they verified it which I know they haven't verified nothing. There has been no consent that I gave or permission to do so which make this account be in violation.
